fixture_rule: Use each frozen v1-v7 typed prompt and the exact primary DSL defined by selection-policy.json. Asset descriptors must be independently computed from the final approved local manifest and compiled source. Compute hashes with the frozen canonical vectors. A future compiler output may supply test input, but it cannot define expected plan semantics, asset admission, hashes or behavior.

cases.assert: Assemble saved bundle in a new process with only pinned assets. Original CNL and models are unavailable. Complete files equal direct generate.
Canonical full bundles match for both input formats and across independent process replay.
Pair prompt v1/v2 with DSL v1; v3-v6 with DSL v2; v7 with DSL v3. Validate all full bindings.

Replace standard get with approved checked variant and its exact selected helpers using the public constructor recipe, update canonical hashes. Semantic validation and independent behavior must pass; assembler must not demand primary-plan equality.

cases.change: Remove the full typed binding context.
Send duplicate version or prompt members in raw compile/assemble JSON.
Change a selected block name without updating hashes.
Change declared catalog digest and recompute payload hash.
Change declared selection policy ID and recompute payload hash.
Change a required typed reference to an unknown binding and recompute hashes.
Remove a requested v6/v7 operation block and its router-close reference, preserving the remaining dependency references; recompute hashes.
Reverse two requested v6/v7 operation blocks and recompute hashes.
Remove a mandatory v7 plan inverse and recompute hashes; existing semantic validator remains the code authority.
Change an installed approved block source, formatter binary, formatter profile or manifest while preserving other files.
Change an installed block and rehash its local manifest. Compiled admission identities must still reject it.
Remove one required local asset in an isolated startup fixture.
Exceed compile 262144 bytes or assemble 2097152 bytes; keep generate its old bound.
Exceed the existing family file/block/tree limits without a model token check.

cases.assert: A valid compact product above65536 bytes remains accepted and its full size is reported.

observations: No compiler or assembler execution is claimed. Missing, unrun and failed results must be preserved.
